L31·N4987unmasked layer
Fires on the final content word closing a descriptive/evaluative clause (right before the period) in casual, personal, enthusiastic prose — e.g. "readability has **increased**.", "fall in love with **it**.", "tells her **story** with humor", "Knitted **Design**." — while being strongly suppressed on mid-sentence function words in technical/FAQ or corporate text ("the", "at", "using", "partner").
